rubric_intent: Score a notes-style document on engineering substance — i.e., how much real technical content vs. placeholder.

dimensions.name: Technical Specificity
dimensions.description: Measures whether the document contains concrete engineering details (APIs, data structures, algorithms, file paths, versions) rather than vague references.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Scan for named identifiers, code symbols, library/version numbers, file paths, protocols, or numeric parameters. Count distinct concrete technical nouns vs. abstract placeholders.

dimensions.name: Problem Framing
dimensions.description: Measures whether the document defines an engineering problem with constraints, inputs, outputs, and success criteria.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for an explicit problem statement, requirements list, constraints section, or stated goals. Check whether the reader could restate what is being solved after reading.

dimensions.name: Design Reasoning
dimensions.description: Measures presence of trade-off analysis, alternatives considered, or rationale for design choices.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Search for words like 'because', 'instead of', 'trade-off', 'alternative', 'vs', or comparative tables. Note whether choices are justified or merely asserted.

dimensions.name: Evidence and Validation
dimensions.description: Measures whether claims are backed by benchmarks, measurements, citations, code references, or reproducible procedures.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Look for numbers with units, links, citations, commit SHAs, benchmark tables, or commands the reader could run. Distinguish opinion from measured claims.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.description: Measures whether the document contains concrete next steps, implementation guidance, or pseudocode/code that an engineer could act on.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Scan for code blocks, command-line examples, step-by-step procedures, checklists, or named TODOs with enough specificity to execute.

dimensions.name: Completion State
dimensions.description: Measures whether the document is a finished artifact vs. a placeholder or stub (e.g., 'todo: write this up later').
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Compute ratio of placeholder markers ('TODO', 'TBD', 'write later', 'fixme') to substantive paragraphs. Inspect overall length and section coverage relative to its stated topic.

dimensions.name: Scope Coherence
dimensions.description: Measures whether the document stays focused on a single engineering topic and develops it, rather than drifting or being too thin to evaluate.
dimensions.evidence_instructions: Identify the apparent topic from title/headers and check whether body content develops that topic. Note tangents, context-free fragments, or missing connective tissue.
